'''Efa''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] collector living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Along with fellow Jawas [[Kitit]] and [[Nbat]], Efa was the one to discover an old [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], containing information on the excavation of [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison]]. Trade Master [[Thint]] later relayed that information to an agent of the Sith Empire.
